_meta.description: Source register. Every published value on this site points at one of these sources. Status 'fetched' means the page was actually retrieved in some session and read; 'cited' means the link is supplied for manual review and its wording was not re-verified in this environment (egress allowlist) - those are flagged FLG-05.
